verdict.rationale: Qodo's pricing FAQ says it does not train models on customer code and uses that code only to generate reviews. Its plans list strict data retention. Self-hosted and air-gapped deployment options also let teams keep data entirely in their own infrastructure. missing for 10: in-depth first-party privacy/DPA documentation of the no-training commitment, scope beyond 'code' (e.g., chat/PR metadata), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: No. Qodo does not train models on your code. Your code is used only to generate reviews for your team.
Deploy Qodo entirely within your own infrastructure.
including multi-tenant, single-tenant, on-premises, and air-gapped options
